From generosity to impact: How Vanguard Charitable connects donors to trusted nonprofits

Here’s how Vanguard Charitable makes it easy for donor-advised fund holders to discover, verify, and support nonprofits and causes they care about—combining their grant team’s expertise Candid’s data—and how nonprofits can boost their profile.

November 23, 2026 By Vicky Kelberer

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:14
Instaread

Nonprofits do the work that changes lives. At Vanguard Charitable, we help donors support that work effortlessly, whether they’re sustaining a local community organization, discovering a new cause, or sending disaster relief.

Donor-advised funds (DAFs) make it easy to turn generosity into meaningful support: Donors can recommend grants, establish recurring giving, and invest charitable assets with the potential to increase their impact over time. In fiscal year 2026, Vanguard Charitable donors granted over $4 billion to nonprofits, up 29.2% from the previous year, supporting nearly 70,000 organizations. That included more than $2.1 billion—half the total—in unrestricted support, which gives nonprofits flexibility to address their most pressing needs. For nonprofits, DAFs represent an opportunity to connect with committed donors who have already dedicated resources to charitable giving. The question is: How can we make sure donors are finding and supporting the most transparent, trustworthy, and effective nonprofits? To connect donors with reliable information about nonprofits, we partner with Candid.

Making giving easier, from discovery to grant

Our goal is to make finding and supporting charities more intuitive and effortless, from discovering an organization to recommending a grant. A donor seeking to help should not be slowed down by a confusing search or a cumbersome transaction.

So in 2025, we launched a new grantmaking platform to make giving faster, clearer, and easier. We cut the time needed to submit a grant recommendation by more than half; donors’ satisfaction with the experience increased from 75% to 93%.

Candid and Vanguard Charitable bring complementary strengths to this work: Candid makes nonprofit information accessible and usable, and Vanguard Charitable brings that information into the giving experience. Together, we help donors understand organizations’ missions, programs, and results so they can make informed decisions. The standard for nonprofit information—publicly available information from Form 990 tax filings—is at least a year and a half old by the time it’s released by the IRS. We work with Candid because it provides more recent data, directly contributed by nonprofits via their profiles.

Trusted data. Confident giving.

We also use Candid’s data to power an essential part of our grants due diligence process. Candid profiles help us verify a nonprofit’s eligibility and IRS standing. Our grants team also reviews the grant to ensure it meets IRS requirements; for example, the funds must be intended solely for charitable purposes and not allow the donor to receive a good or service with financial value.

That work is central to the trust donors place in us. By combining Candid’s nonprofit data with Vanguard Charitable’s grantmaking expertise and oversight, we help donors give confidently. We take on the research and administrative work, so donors can focus on the causes they care about.

Meeting moments of urgent need

When disaster strikes, donors want to help. DAF donors are uniquely positioned to act quickly, given that charitable resources are already set aside and ready to deploy. Over a recent 12-month period, Vanguard Charitable donors recommended $86 million for disaster-related causes.

Our new integrated disaster response tools make acting on generosity easier. Built into the donor portal, they let donors explore disaster response opportunities and recommend a grant in just a few clicks, without switching between websites or copying charity information into their account.

Alongside these tools, Candid data helps advance a simple goal: to meet the moment of urgent need and generosity with the ease of giving donors need and expect.

What’s coming: AI-enabled giving built on trusted data

Looking ahead, our focus is on AI-enabled features that offer donors a more intuitive giving experience. But meaningful AI-enabled experiences require more than a conversational interface: They must be grounded in reliable, structured information. Candid provides a shared data foundation for both discovery and grants due diligence, helping us ensure our answers are based on trusted information.

Our aim is to make giving easier without compromising the rigorous checks behind it. AI can help donors explore and learn; eligibility checks, grants review, and human oversight remain essential to responsible grantmaking.

Make your nonprofit part of the opportunity

As I explained in a recent webinar, our donor portal presents an opportunity for nonprofits to tell their story and boost visibility today and in the donor experiences we are working toward. Engaging DAF donors starts with making your organization easy to discover, understand, and support.

  • Tell your story transparently. Regularly update your Candid profile so donors don’t have to rely on IRS releases, clearly describe your programs and impact, and maintain your Seal of Transparency.
  • Make DAF giving visible. Include your legal name, EIN, and clear giving instructions on your website and in fundraising communications.
  • Build lasting relationships. When donor information is available, thank donors, share the difference their support makes, and invite recurring grants.

By partnering with Candid, Vanguard Charitable is giving donors the information, confidence, and tools they need to act, while helping nonprofits gain visibility and support.
